comparison.objective: Pose two friction-jointed helping hands so two wire ends cross over a mark; candidate registers proximity switches.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-joint support-arm posing and wire-end spatial alignment versus constrained linear sensor adjustment and screw fastening.
comparison.success_condition: Both wire ends must cross at the target with the articulated supports stable and released; candidate needs two sensed geometric states retained after tightening.
comparison.reason: The record tests articulated pose composition, not sensing-based mounted-component calibration or fastening under pose retention.
